neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The same product-to-derivative template applied to the elliptic xi function separates conductor, gamma, and local arithmetic components and recovers the elliptic explicit formula.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: Across Dirichlet, elliptic, and Dedekind completions, logarithmic differentiation separates conductor and gamma terms from prime or prime-ideal sums, so the architecture transfers while the cancellation problem changes weights.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: Character phases or local sign changes are only plausibility for cancellation, and the Dedekind formula still carries an explicit convergence-justification gate.
